description: Job search API for AI agents: Google Jobs listings as JSON for a role, company or location. Returns job titles, employers, locations, posting details and application links when available for hiring research and job discovery. Price: 5 prepaid credits per successful call. MCP returns a compact view of these results.

language.description: Language or locale code for job results.

results.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.
